description:
Short stories capturing the bittersweet and tender moments of everyday family life, made for Marukome Co., Ltd. a miso soup paste manufacturer.

List of commercials:
• #1: Mother and Son (たっぷりお徳 母と息子篇)
• #2: Working away from Home (即席生みそ汁 単身赴任篇)
• #3: A Midnight Snack (カップみそ汁 夜食篇)
• #4: Coming to Tokyo (液みそ 上京篇)
• #5: Being a mother (無添加 母になれば篇)
• #6: Miso Soup (お徳用あおさ ミソスープ篇)
• #7: Home Sick Together (米麦合わせ ふたりでおやすみ篇)
• #8: Together Forever (液みそ いつまでも一緒に篇)
• #9: Look After Yourself (フリーズドライ 顆粒みそ 気をつけてね篇)
• #10: Memories of Summer Vacation (夏休みの思い出篇)
• #11: My Whimsical Little Boy (息⼦にはかなわない篇)
• #12: Home for the Holidays (帰省篇)
• #13: Cooking Is Super Cool (料理ってすごいね篇)
• #14: My grandma (わたしのおばあちゃん篇)
